title: What counts as shipped
content: Work is shipped when it is in the hands of whoever needed it: a pull request merged, an issue closed, a release published, or a review that let someone else's change land. Not when the code is written, not when the tests pass, and not when it is waiting for review — those are in progress. A change merged behind a feature flag is shipped; the decision to turn the flag on is separate work.

title: The log describes work, never measures it
content: This workflow reports what was done and what it is waiting on. It never reports commit counts, lines changed, hours spent, or any comparison against another day or another person. Those numbers do not measure engineering work, and a log that carries them stops being written honestly.
